chunks: Then Lot believed in him; and (Abraham) said: "I will separate myself and take refuge in my Lord. Surely He is all-mighty and all-wise."

key_terms.مُهَاجِرٌ: Migrant, one who emigrates for the sake of God

ai.seo_question: What does the verse say about Lot's faith and Abraham's migration to God?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Lot (AS) affirms his faith in Abraham (AS), while Abraham declares his migration (hijrah) to his Lord, establishing a theological link between the two prophets. This declaration underscores the concept of hijrah not merely as physical relocation but as a spiritual return to the Divine, grounded in God's attributes of Might (Al-Aziz) and Wisdom (Al-Hakim). Shia exegesis often highlights this as a model of steadfastness and reliance on God's ultimate authority amidst worldly trials.
